translationRepairs: On xinwei in the fifth month he ennobled his forebears: great-grandfather Jing as emperor Ruihe, temple Xinzu, and great-grandmother Lady Zhang as empress Ruigong;

On xinwei in the fifth month he posthumously honored his ancestors as emperors and ancestresses as empresses: great-great-grandfather Jing, posthumous title Ruihe, temple name Xinzu; great-great-grandmother Lady Zhang, posthumous title Ruigong;

Focus unit has 高祖璟 followed by 曾祖諶, 祖蘊, and 考: 高祖 is the fourth-generation ancestor (great-great-grandfather), not great-grandfather. The before text reverses the 高祖/曾祖 generation labels; the proposed wording restores great-great-grandfather/great-great-grandmother and correctly renders 追尊 and 謚曰 as posthumous honor and posthumous title.
great-great-grandfather Chen as emperor Mingxian, temple Xizu, and great-great-grandmother Lady Shen as empress Mingxiao;
great-grandfather Chen, posthumous title Mingxian, temple name Xizu; great-grandmother Lady Shen, posthumous title Mingxiao;

Focus unit names 曾祖諶 between 高祖璟 and 祖蘊; 曾祖 is great-grandfather. Calling him great-great-grandfather contradicts the Chinese kinship ladder; the proposed great-grandfather/great-grandmother labels and posthumous-title phrasing match 謚曰 and 廟號.
